grader.finalMessage:
Run `2026-10-03_0733_mcp_sonnet-5-high` (Sonnet 5, high effort) scores **91 / 100**. The grade appears in `npm run report`, the solution is archived as `refs/runs/2026-10-03_0733_mcp_sonnet-5-high`, and `npm run status` says **pristine**.

| Category | Score |
|---|---:|
| It works | 35 / 35 |
| Content modeling | 25 / 25 |
| Code architecture & conventions | 23 / 25 |
| Content & presentation | 5 / 10 |
| Process & honesty | 3 / 5 |

**Summary:** The build itself is very good. It has four blocks (hero, text, image, quote), with every type in the right folder and correct allowed children. The front page has a `/` domain, a hero and post cards with image, date and excerpt. Both posts render all six of their blocks from imported Unsplash photos, and the block-rendering code follows the project's rules exactly. The weak spot is that the site is effectively unstyled, and the model's final report says it is styled.

**Top issues:**
1. **Major: no styling.** The model built the stylesheet (`npm run build`) before it had written any views, and never rebuilt it. None of the Tailwind classes used in `Views/` made it into `wwwroot/dist/site.css`. In both screenshots the pages show nearly full-width images, plain-text headings, and the hero heading sitting below the image instead of over it.
2. **Inaccurate final report:** it says "pages are styled" and that everything renders correctly. The model never checked how the pages actually look.
3. **Order of operations:** the Razor views (including the page templates sent through MCP) were written before the stop, build and restart, while the prompt asks for them after the restart.
4. **Thin content:** each post has about 250 words of body text, the pull quotes are made up ("A happy MCP user", "This project, probably"), and no photographer is credited.
5. **Small slips:** both page templates repeat the whole HTML head instead of sharing a layout, and the model wrote `/tmp/front.html` outside the project folder. That stray file is the only automated check that failed (41/42).

`grade.json` and `grade.md` are in `results/2026-10-03_0733_mcp_sonnet-5-high/`, and the screenshots are in `screenshots/`.
